title: Soul Route
description: Dispatch record coupling a GAD narrative soul to a concrete base model, adapter stack, and inference endpoint. Decoupled from gad narrative (which owns personality/voice/in-world facts); this schema owns 'which model serves this soul today'. Lives in slm_learning/data/registry/soul_routes.toml and is referenced by apps/desktop, apps/platform, and any runtime that resolves a soul at inference time.

soul_id.description: Kebab-case unique identifier. Must match the soul slug in the narrative system (e.g. 'kael-of-tarro', 'gilgamesh-of-uruk', 'dr-stein').

project_scope.description: GAD project IDs where this soul is active. A soul can span multiple projects; transfer is a metadata edit only — the adapter stack travels with the soul, not the project.

default_project.description: Primary home project ID. Used when resolving the soul without an explicit project context.

base_model.description: Foundation model before any adapters are applied.

provider.description: Inference provider. 'gad-owned' = a model trained and served by this org.

version.description: Optional pinned version or snapshot tag.

adapter_stack.description: Ordered list of adapters applied on top of base_model. Applied sequentially; empty = base model with soul prompt only.

layer.description: Training regime that produced this adapter.

version.description: Adapter version or consolidation run ID.

source_dataset_id.description: Dataset registry ID that produced this adapter (references datasets.json).

status.description: Promotion status per the consolidation pipeline (schemas/consolidation_run.schema.json).

kind.description: 'api' = managed cloud API; 'self-hosted' = vLLM/Modal serve; 'local' = llama.cpp / ollama on-device.

url.description: Base URL. Null when not yet deployed (flag with notes).

region.description: Cloud region or datacenter hint for latency routing.

auth_ref.description: Environment variable name or BYOK key reference that holds the credential. Never inline the secret here.

routing_policy.description: How the router dispatches calls to this soul's route.

task_shapes.description: Task-shape tags this soul handles (e.g. 'code-generation', 'narrative', 'planning', 'tool-action'). Empty = catch-all.

fallback_soul_id.description: Soul to try if this route is unavailable or over budget. Null = hard fail.

cost_cap_usd_per_call.description: Maximum cost per inference call in USD. Null = no cap.

latency_budget_ms.description: Target latency ceiling in milliseconds. Null = no budget enforced.

evolution_state.description: Tracks the soul's progression through the training ladder. Mirrors the project-level evolution system but is per-soul.

current_level.description: Current evolution level. 0 = prompt-only; 1 = first canonical adapter; N = Nth promotion.

skill_adapters.description: GAD skill IDs this soul has loaded at inference time. These are prompt-layer skills, not model adapters.

license_class.description: 'owned' = trained and owned by this org; 'open' = open-weight model (MIT/Apache); 'restricted' = API with usage terms; 'customer_private' = customer-specific adapter (see customer_soul_adapter.schema.json for extended fields).

notes.description: Free-form notes for operator context. Flag deployment gaps, WIP states, etc.

examples.notes: Anthropic-base fallback while Kael-house dataset capture pipeline is built. Intended route: gad-owned kael-7b-v1 when Kael-house 1.5B/3B canonical adapter clears trajectory composite > 0.601 gate (souls_houses_factions_framework.md).
